title: Defibrillation Using an AED
content_markdown:
#### Indications

- To deliver DCCS in a pulseless, unconscious patient presenting with: 
- Ventricular Fibrillation (VF).
- Pulseless Ventricular Tachycardia (VT).

#### Procedure

- Confirm cardiac arrest - unresponsive, apnoeic and no palpable central pulse: 
- Multiple people using multiple checks at multiple times.

- Begin cardiac arrest algorithm (CPR).

- Open the AED case.

- Press the ON/OFF button. 
- Follow the AED prompts to apply pads. (Note you may apply the pads before prompted).
- Roll pads onto patient's bare chest.
- Anterior/posterior placement preferred if timely and accessible.
- Ensure good pad adherence.
- Follow prompts to analyse rhythm and “Stay clear of patient”.

- If a shock is advised, the AED will prompt “Shock advised” and the SHOCK button will flash accompanied by a prompt to deliver the shock.

- Ensure everyone is clear.

- Press the SHOCK button as prompted.

- Once the patient has been shocked/no shock advised, the AED will prompt “Begin CPR” and will re-analyse the patient again in two minutes.

#### Specific Notes

- AED monitoring occurs via pads only.
- Device may be used in event of cardiac monitor failure.
- Select paediatric mode specific to AED (e.g. button on Zoll, Pink key on Phillips).
